curated_examples.4d-lung.open-manifest.croissant.jsonld: Public DICOM with IDC downstream storage/access route.
curated_examples.cmb-aml.radiology-pathology-external-cli: Controlled CTDC radiology manifest, open radiology manifest, Aspera pathology package, PathDB pathology search URL, and external clinical-resource signal.
curated_examples.hnscc.mixed-access.croissant.jsonld: Mixed access with controlled DICOM manifests routed through General Commons.
curated_examples.saros.analysis-result-nifti-derived.croi: Analysis Result with open NIfTI segmentations and mixed-access source image context.

notes: The full generated corpus is not included in this share folder.
Example JSON-LD files are representative samples.
A091105 examples are intentionally excluded because that dataset is currently offline pending CTDC migration.
Manifest classification is based on TCIA download-requirements metadata, not file extension.
Schema.org catalog, conditionsOfAccess, search system, and Analysis Result source-context fields are included to support website integration guidance.
